MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 11
   D. 7

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 23
   D. 19

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

4. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

5. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 0

6. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 1

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

8. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

9. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

11. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 10

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

14. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 3

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
